summary: This bill increases funding for a grant program that helps food banks acquire infrastructure like refrigeration and transportation, prioritizing underserved communities, and requires a study on national cold storage needs for emergency food organizations.

scores.thoughts: This bill increases authorized funding for the EFAP infrastructure grants program from $15 million to $25 million annually for fiscal years 2026-2030, and also appropriates $1 million for a study on cold storage needs. This represents a clear increase in government spending.

The bill aims to improve the infrastructure for emergency food assistance programs (EFAP) by increasing funding for grants to food banks and related organizations, particularly in underserved areas. This directly supports and expands the social safety net by enhancing food distribution to people in need.
